correctness.rationale: PASS: Spectral projectors for L(K1,m) at eigenvalues 0,1,m+1 yield four rational entry forms. Offdiagonals equal h[(m+1)h+6]/Db and h²[(m+1)h²+(6m+12)h+18]/(Da Db), so positive for all h>0. The only obstructions are hub quadratic H_m and leaf quartic F_m. Exact minimum R(x)>-(3 sqrt 3-5)/2 and delta<1/10 establish diagonal positivity for 2<=m<=10. For m>=11 hub discriminant 4(m²-10m-2) gives two roots below 2; F_m positive on [0,3], negative at 8, eventually positive, while Descartes allows at most two positive roots: exactly two simple leaf crossings >3. The two disjoint bad intervals yield three closed safe windows. Independent SymPy identities, rational isolations at m=10,11,12,20,100 and exact large-m asymptotic coefficient checks support, but do not prove, the all-m result.

value.rationale: PASS: The nonmonotone endpoint-positivity region of a standard stiff integrator is a meaningful obstruction for graph diffusion and positivity-preserving timesteps. Two distinct diagonal obstructions produce a sharp smallest graph (12 states) and three disconnected feasible windows, including a finite [2,3] central window and a late O(m) recovery. This cannot be read off graph-independent absolute-monotonicity radii.

limitations: Unindexed specialized numerical-analysis calculations may have already identified the star graph quartic or three-window phenomenon.
